text: The new paste/drag case calls equal twice without a third message argument. The comments explain the cases but do not provide assertion messages. A focused repair should name the expected shifted series and exception start dates in nonempty messages that contain should. These are the two added assertions; no unrelated assertions or runtime result are included.
title: The new recurrence shift assertions need explicit failure messages
